units: metres, glTF space (+Y up, character faces +Z), origin = seat point (underside of the bottom at sit frame 0)
standGroundY_note: lowest stand vertex measured in the re-imported v2 GLB is -0.4211 (Draco quantisation); -0.4228 is the pre-export value

standup.note: legacy fallback (stands up in place), unused

hopdown.note: baked hip motion is exactly linear (constant velocity) between takeoff and land; feet planted from land to end (drift < 2 mm); page adds its extra drop between takeoff and land

hopup.note: feet planted from 0 to takeoff (drift 0); land = bottom touches the seat; baked hip motion linear between takeoff and land

leap.note: in place: no baked x travel, Hips z (forward) within 1.9 cm of sit; hips stay exactly at sit height while seated (0-0.12 s and from land on), rise 3 cm into takeoff, linear between takeoff and land. Symmetric left/right; page adds lateral travel, arc, yaw/roll and head look.

walk.note: in place, faces +Z. Move the root forward (along his facing) at `speed` m/s = `strideLength` per cycle and the planted foot does not slide (stance feet are IK-locked to exactly this speed). Times are within the loop; each foot is planted from contact to liftoff (wrapping). Hips centred on the stand pose (x 0.1067, z 0.42 like stand). t=0 = passing position, left foot in mid-stance.

walkstart.note: eased blend with a small forward lean; ramp the root speed from 0 to walk.speed over this clip

walkstop.from: walk t=0 (passing, left foot in stance)
walkstop.note: start it when the walk loop wraps to t=0; ramp the root speed from walk.speed to 0 over this clip

standOffsetFromSeat.note: stand frame 0 Hips minus sit frame 0 Hips (sit Hips at y 0.2376, stand Hips at y 0.562); baked into hopdown/hopup/standup

seat.note: sit loop, all frames: underside of bottom/thighs pressed flat on y=0. yMin = deepest point, yMax = largest gap of any 1 cm x-slice across xMin..xMax. zFront/zBack = depth of the contact patch (glTF +Z forward). The centre of the buttocks between y-depth -0.03 and +0.05 m sits ~12 mm up, hidden behind the thighs.

hands.note: lowest point of each hand (fingertip pads) at sit frame 0, glTF space; planted for the whole sit loop (no change across frames)
